paragraph_text: The Beneficiary satisfies 8 C.F.R. §204.5(h)(3)(i) by demonstrating receipt of nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field. The Beneficiary was selected as a scholar of Beijing's 'Hundred People Project,' a prestigious talent recognition program that identifies and supports exceptional academics in the capital region [Exhibit A1, p.2]. This selection demonstrates that the Beneficiary's scholarly work has been recognized at the highest levels of academic administration in Beijing, as the program is designed to identify and cultivate leading researchers who contribute significantly to their fields [Exhibit A1, p.2]. The 'Hundred People Project' represents a highly competitive selection process, as it identifies only a limited number of scholars from among the many researchers working in Beijing's numerous academic institutions [Exhibit A1, p.2]. This award places the Beneficiary among an elite group of scholars recognized for their potential to make significant contributions to their academic disciplines [Exhibit A1, p.2]. Furthermore, the Beneficiary's work 'On Age' won the third prize of Outstanding Achievements in Humanities and Social Sciences of the Ministry of Education of China, a nationally recognized award established by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China in 2009 to reward researchers who have made outstanding contributions in the field of humanities and social sciences [Exhibit A1, p.2; Exhibit B10, p.2; Exhibit B10, p.4]. This award is administered through a rigorous evaluation process conducted every three years by an Award Committee composed of the director, deputy directors of the Social Sciences Committee of the Ministry of Education, and heads of relevant departments, with evaluation committees selecting experts and scholars with high academic attainments from across the country to review submissions [Exhibit B10, p.4; Exhibit B10, p.5]. The award structure includes grand prizes, first prizes, second prizes, and third prizes, with the Beneficiary's third prize representing recognition among the top tier of submissions in a national competition that evaluates books, dissertations, research reports, and popularization achievements from higher education institutions across China [Exhibit B10, p.4; Exhibit B10, p.5]. This achievement demonstrates that the Beneficiary's scholarly work has been evaluated and recognized as meeting the award's stringent criteria of having clear viewpoints, sufficient arguments, accurate data, strict logic, scientific methods, and being innovative and cutting-edge while conforming to academic ethics and norms [Exhibit B10, p.6]. In addition to these academic honors, the Beneficiary received the Data Awards Data Legacy of the Year Award in 2019, a prestigious recognition in the field of mobile Internet and big data that is jointly launched by Umen+, Zhongguancun Big Data Industry Alliance, Tsingdata Big Data Industries Association, and China Big Data Industry Observation [Exhibit B1, p.2; Exhibit B3, p.3]. This award is described as one of the most influential awards in the field of mobile Internet, with a rigorous selection process involving a jury of 21 judges from dozens of authorities and industry experts and scholars including China Academy of Information and Communications Technology, Tsinghua University, and Peking University during a two-month review period [Exhibit B3, p.2; Exhibit B3, p.3]. The Data Legacy of the Year Award recognizes individuals who have been working deeply in the field of big data and mobile Internet for many years, spreading their insights and experiences and educating the whole industry, with only 28 Data individuals standing out from the competition across seven categories of Data Awards [Exhibit B3, p.4; Exhibit B3, p.7]. This places the Beneficiary among an elite group of data professionals recognized at the same event where other award categories included Most Influential Award of the Year and Best Data Practice Award of the Year, with winners described as veterans in the field of mobile Internet and leaders in the process of data intelligence [Exhibit B3, p.6; Exhibit B3, p.8]. Moreover, the Beneficiary, along with co-author Chen Cui, won the Excellent Paper Award at the 11th China Communication Conference for their paper titled 'Challenges Posed by the Internet to Traditional Media in the Time Dimension - A Study on the Possibility of Internet Media Usage Time Surpassing Traditional Media Usage Time.' [Exhibit B11, p.2]. This award was conferred by the Communication Association of China through the 11th China Communication Conference Organizing Committee, indicating recognition from the premier professional organization for communication studies in China [Exhibit B11, p.2]. The China Communication Conference represents a major national gathering of communication scholars and professionals, with the Excellent Paper Award recognizing outstanding scholarly contributions presented at this prestigious event [Exhibit B11, p.2]. This achievement demonstrates that the Beneficiary's research has been evaluated and recognized as meeting high academic standards by peers in the field of communication studies at a national level conference [Exhibit B11, p.2]. Beyond these specific recognitions, the Beneficiary's professional achievements have been recognized through additional industry and enterprise awards, including recognition from 36 Kr as an Enterprise Service High-growth Company and selection as China Big Data Industry Application TOP Choice in Three Major Fields [Exhibit B4, p.4]. These awards demonstrate that the Beneficiary's work has been evaluated and recognized by multiple industry organizations and media outlets as representing excellence in enterprise service growth and big data industry applications [Exhibit B4, p.4]. The recognition from 36 Kr, a prominent technology media company, and the designation as China Big Data Industry Application TOP Choice indicate that the Beneficiary's contributions have been assessed as standing out among competitors in the technology and big data sectors [Exhibit B4, p.4]. These additional awards complement the Beneficiary's other recognitions by showing consistent excellence across multiple domains of professional achievement, from academic research to industry application and enterprise growth [Exhibit B4, p.4]. In sum, the foregoing evidence clearly establishes that the Beneficiary has received nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field.
